title: Fix premature context.Cancel in scheduler engine store operations
description:
**Bug**: In `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine.go`, at least 6 sites call `cancel()` immediately after a store operation instead of using `defer cancel()`. Lines: 235-237, 249-271, 356-359, 371-375, 545-551.

Example:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), storeOpTimeout)
state, err := e.jobStore.GetState(ctx, jobID)
cancel()  // ← should be defer cancel()
```

**Fix**: Replace all `cancel()` calls with `defer cancel()` immediately after context creation. Audit entire file for this pattern.

**Files**: `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine.go`
definitionOfDone: All context.WithTimeout in engine.go use defer cancel()

Run `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/...` to verify no regressions.

reopenReason:
DoD items 1 and 2 not met. Line 344-346 in engine.go still has a non-deferred cancel() on a store operation:

```go
// Line 343-346
if e.jobStore != nil {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(e.ctx, storeOpTimeout)
    a, err := e.jobStore.GetAttempts(ctx, jobID)
    cancel()  // ← should be defer cancel()
```

Fix: Change L344-346 to:
```go
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(e.ctx, storeOpTimeout)
    defer cancel()
    a, err := e.jobStore.GetAttempts(ctx, jobID)
```

All other instances were correctly converted. This is the only remaining one.
